PATIT PABAN DEBNATH  S/O- SRI BROJENDRA DEBNATH, R/O- VILL- NAMDANG BASHBARI, P.O.
 AND P.S. MARGHERITA, DIST.- TINSUKIA, ASSAM  VERSUS  THE STATE OF ASSAM AND 3 ORS.
REP BY THE COMM. AND SECY., GOVT. OF ASSAM,URBAN DEVELOPMENT  DEPTT., DISPUR, GHY-06 ASSAM
2:THE DIRECTOR  TOWN AND COUNTRY PLANNING  DISPUR  GHY-6  3:THE DY. COMMISSIONER  TINSUKIA
4 : THE MARGHERITA MUNICIPAL BOARD  MARGHERITA
BEING REP. BY THE EXECUTIVE OFFICE Advocate for the Petitioner : MR. S P CHOUDHURY Advocate for the Respondent : GA, ASSAM
BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRASANTA KUMAR DEKA  ORDER Date : 30-03-2021 Heard Mr. S. P. Choudhury, learned counsel for the petitioner.

Ms. K.Phukan,
learned State Counsel is present alongwith the instruction as directed vide order dated 16.3.2021.

The petitioner entered into an agreement for sale with Sukumar Choudhury and Narayan Choudhury, the vendors in respect of the land whereupon the said Sukumar Choudhury and Narayan Choudhury were running chowmin factory and biscuit bakery on the basis of trade licenses issued in Page No.# 3/5 their names by the Margherita Municipal Board.

As there was alleged violation of the terms of the agreement for sale, the petitioner as the plaintiff filed Title Suit No.
2/2021 in the court of learned Civil Judge, Tinsukia for specific performance of contract against the said two vendors who were impleaded as the defendants .

Alongwith the said suit Misc (J) Case no.
4/2021 was also filed and the learned court below was satisfied to pass an order of interim Patit Paban Debnath vs The State Of Assam And 3 Ors on 30 March, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40640321/
2 injunction directing the parties to the suit to maintain status quo in respect of the possession and nature of the suit land till disposal of the suit.

sentences.text: On the basis of the said agreement for sale the vendors permitted the petitioner to run the chowmin factory and biscuit bakery on specific terms and conditions vide deed of lease agreement dated 2.12.2019.
On the basis of the said lease agreement the petitioner started paying the lease rent and ran the said factory and bakery .

On 10.1.2021 a notice was issued by the Executive Officer, Margherita Municipal Board to the petitioner with a direction to produce trade licenses on the basis of which the petitioner had been running the said factory after alleging that the petitioner was running the said business of biscuit bakery and chowmin factories without obtaining trade licence from the said office of Margherita Municipal Board.
Similar notices were issued to the vendors of the petitioner on 10.1.2021.

On 29.1.2021 the said two vendors surrendered the trade licenses standing in their names and informed the Executive Officer, Margherita Municipal Board about winding up of their business w.e.f. 29.12.2020.

After the said act of surrender of the respective licenses the Executive Officer, Margherita Municipal Board as submitted by Mr. Choudhury, sealed both the factory premises alongwith the perishable goods in the said premises of the factory on 11.2.2021.

The petitioner referring to notice dated 10.1.2021 informed the Executive Officer, Margherita Municipal Board about the order passed on 28.1.2021 by the learned Civil Judge , Tinsukia directing the parties to maintain status quo and not to change the character and nature of the suit land.

Mr. Choudhury submitted that the action initiated by the Executive Officer, Margherita Municipal Board is clear case of violation of principle of natural justice inasmuch as prior to said act of sealing no notice was served on the petitioner to show cause as to why necessary action would not be taken against the petitioner for failure to obtain the trade license.

As per instruction received by Ms.
Phukan the relevant portion of the instruction is extracted hereinbelow:
"4.
That on 25.1.2021 Sri Sukumnar Chowdhury and Narayan Chowdhury submitted two separate applications to cancel trade license of their chowmin noodles factory and biscuit bakery.

On 29.12.2020 they submitted a received copy of their applications dtd. 23.12.2020 whereby they surrendered their license to the designated officer, Licensing Authority,
Jorhat, Assam issued under Food Safety & Standard Act, 2006 by Commissioner of Food Safety Assam ( Health & Family Department ) which was valid up to 26.1.2021.(Copy of said applications are enclosed and marked as document No.
4,5,6,7 respectively).Thereafter they submitted two orders dtd 12.1.2021 passed by Assistant Labour Commissioner, Tinsukia stating that " The certificate of registration of the Establishment has been cancelled with immediate effect as the business in the establishment M/s Ram Krishna Food Product Page No.# 4/5 and M/S Ram Krishna Bakery has already wound up w.e.f. 15th December, 2020.(Copies of aforesaid two orders dtd 12.1.2021 issued by the Assistant Labour Commissioner, Tinsukia are enclosed and marked as document number 8 and 9).

5. That on receipt of application dtd. 25.1.2021 Sri Sukumnar Chowdhury and Narayan Chowdhury undersigned issued order on 29th Jan, 2021 which is as follows:
Patit Paban Debnath vs The State Of Assam And 3 Ors on 30 March, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40640321/
3 "

sentences.text: In pursuance of the trade license Act under section 68 & 336 sub-section -I of Assam Municipal Act, 1956.

Sri Narayan Choudhury proprietor of Ram Krishna Bakery located at No. 1 Lazum under Margherita Town has surrendered the trade license No. 688/MMB/03/2021, dtd 15.12.2020 and wound up his business w.e.f.
29.12.2020.

The trade license has cancelled with immediate effect in the title of Ram Krishna Bakery w.e.f. 29.12.2020" and " In pursuance of the license Act under Section 68 &
336 sub-section 1 of Assam Municipal Act, 1956.

Sri Sukumar Choudhury proprietor of Ram Krishna Food Product located at No. 1 Lazum under Margherita Town has surrendered the trade license No. 657/MMB/03/2021, dtd 15.12.2020 and wound up his business w.e.f. 29.12.2020.
The trade license has cancelled with immediate effect in the title of Ram Krishna Bakery w.e.f. 29.12.2020" .
The aforesaid orders have been served upon them.

(Copes of aforesaid two orders dtd. 29.1.2021 and service report i.e. signature of proprietors are annexed marked as documents No. 10 & 11.)
6.

That thereafter they produced two copy of order No. TSK/638/520 and order No.
TSK/637/511 dtd Gauhati 4th Feb, 2021 issued by office of Chief Inspector of Factories, Assam wherein it is mentioned that above mentioned factory M/S Ram Krishna Bakery and M/s Ram Krishna Food Product has been crossed off from the list of registered factories with effect from 3.2.2021.

(copy of said letter dtd 4.2.2021 is annexed and marked as document No. 12 & 13.)
7.
Thereafter two notices being numbers MrgMB/TL/18/Notice/2009-10/1905, dtd 10.2.2021 and MrgMB/TL/18/Notice/2009-10/1906, dtd 10.2.2021 signed by under signed have been served upon them.

(copy of aforesaid orders and service report containing their signature are annexed are marked as documents 14 & 15)
8.
That on 4.3.2021 both the factory was seized vide seizure list dtd 4.3.2021, (copy of the seizure list is enclosed and marked as document number 16)."
The petitioner as stated in the writ petition on the basis of lease deed was permitted to run the said factory and the bakery on the basis of the lease deed after paying the due lease rent .
Mr. Choudhury submitted that the petitioner paid the monthly lease rent without default .

Mr. Choudhury though referred to various provisions of Section 230 and 236 of Assam Municipal Act, 1956 which stipulates the penal provisions for using any public place without any license but I am not inclined to accept the said submission inasmuch the petitioner is operating the said factory and bakery premises on Patit Paban Debnath vs The State Of Assam And 3 Ors on 30 March, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40640321/
4 the basis of a lease deed and as submitted by Mr. Choudhury there was no violation of any of the conditions of the lease deed.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The vendors are bound by terms of the lease.
In Page No.# 5/5 view of the same there is no dispute at bar that it is at the instance of the vendors of the petitioner the trade licenses were surrendered.

This goes to show that the conditions stipulated in the lease deed are relevant for arriving at a decision to the grievance of the petitioner whether the lease deed stipulates specific terms in maintenance of the licenses in the names of the vendors.
The lease deed is not annexed to this writ petition.
Moreover the petitioner had not impleaded the vendors or the lessees in this writ petition.
As the cause of action though submitted by Mr. Choudhury arose out of the action of the Executive Officer, Margherita Municipal Board but I am not convinced to accept the same.

The petitioner is accordingly directed to raise the grievance in the Title Suit No. 2/2021 after impleading the Executive Officer, Margherita Municipal Board and the petitioner shall raise the issue which in my considered opinion is violation of terms of lease deed.

The petitioner may also file a separate suit on the basis of the lease deed entered into by him against the vendors by impleading the Executive Officer, Margherita Municipal Board as one of the defendants. .

Needless to say keeping in view the nature of urgency the petitioner shall file appropriate application u/s 80 of the CPC and the learned court below shall pass appropriate order whereafter the petitioner shall move the subsequent application after making an amendment of the plaint impleading the Executive Officer, Margherita Municipal Board for an appropriate order or in the alternative may file a separate suit if a fresh cause of action has accrued.

In the meantime, till the filing of the appropriate application before the learned Civil Court,
Executive Officer, Margherita Municipal Board is directed to allow the petitioner to take back the perishable goods in the factory premises without any delay.
This writ petition is accordingly disposed of with the aforesaid observation and diretions.
